# Gate manifest (#218, #216): every function the lichen_api headers declare, with the capability that guards it and
# the thread it may be called from. Format: function<TAB>capability<TAB>thread<TAB>header.
# Generated by `tools/check_layers.sh --gen-manifest`, checked against the headers on every build (#220). The
# capability column is a seed (per header, '-' = none) and #229 (capabilities) owns making it right.
# thread: any, lvgl (LVGL task only), not-lvgl, unspecified (the header comment does not say; fix the comment,
# then the entry).
